articles.summary: AI promised to give us hours back. For many people, it has. So why does work still feel just as overwhelming? Explore the "time rebound effect" and learn how to protect the time you saved.
articles.title: AI saved you time. So why are you still so busy?

articles.title: Tool debt: How using too many productivity tools hurts productivity
